meta.title: The Finest Cuisine
meta.description: Trump visits a Michelin-star restaurant but has very specific dietary requirements

script.line: Good evening, sir. Welcome to Le Château Magnifique. Tonight's special is a deconstructed sea urchin foam with—
Yeah yeah yeah. Very fancy. Beautiful place. I've seen fancier, but it's fine. Do you have cheeseburgers?
Sir, this is a three Michelin star establishment. Our chef trained in Paris for—
Paris? I own buildings in Paris. Many buildings. The best buildings.
Perhaps I could interest you in our wagyu beef tartare with—
Is that a burger? Because I want a burger. A beautiful burger. With ketchup. Lots of ketchup.
No ketchup? This is a disaster. A total disaster. Worst restaurant I've ever seen.
I... I'll see what the kitchen can do.
The chef is crying, but... here is your cheeseburger, sir.
Now THAT is beautiful. The most beautiful burger. I'm gonna give this place five stars.
Sir, we already have three Michelin—
Five Trump stars. Much better than Michelin. Those are tire people. What do tire people know about food?
